question: Can I swim with the Stride Sport Earbuds?
expected_answer: They are rated IP68 and survive fresh-water submersion up to 1.5 m for 30 minutes, but they are not designed for swimming: Bluetooth does not work underwater, and salt water or chlorinated pool water should be avoided.

question: how do i factory reset my pulse anc headphones
expected_answer: Turn the headphones on, then hold the power and ANC buttons together for 15 seconds until the LED flashes red three times.

question: can i upgade the ram on the voltbook air 14 to 32gb later?
expected_answer: No. The VoltBook Air 14 has 16 GB of LPDDR5X memory built into the main board, so it cannot be upgraded after purchase.

question: How much RAM can the Gamer 15 take and what type do I need?
expected_answer: It ships with 16 GB of DDR5 in two slots and can be upgraded to a maximum of 64 GB (two 32 GB modules). Use matching DDR5 SO-DIMM modules for dual-channel performance. Damage caused during an upgrade is not covered by the warranty.

question: Does the Nova X come with a charger?
expected_answer: No, a wall charger is not included. The box contains the phone, a 1 m USB-C to USB-C cable, a SIM eject tool and a quick start card. For the fastest charging use a USB-C Power Delivery charger rated at 65 W or more, such as the VoltCharge 65W GaN Charger.

question: can i put a micro sd card in the nova x
expected_answer: No. The Nova X has 256 GB of storage and no microSD slot. The Nova Lite is the only Nova phone with a microSD slot (up to 1 TB).

question: Does the VoltView doorbell work with HomeKit?
expected_answer: No. The VoltView Video Doorbell is not compatible with Apple Home. It works with Amazon Alexa and Google Home, and it still works in the VoltHome app, but it won't appear in the Apple Home app.

question: will the glowbulb connect to my 5ghz wifi?
expected_answer: No. GlowBulb connects only to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. If your router combines both bands under one name and setup fails, temporarily turn off the 5 GHz band or enable a separate 2.4 GHz network.

question: my glowbulb keeps flickering, is it broken??
expected_answer: Flickering usually means the bulb is on a dimmer switch. GlowBulb should not be used with dimmer switches; use a standard on/off switch instead.

question: turbo mode is greyed out on my gaming laptop
expected_answer: On the VoltBook Gamer 15, Turbo mode is only available when the 240 W barrel charger is connected. Check that the barrel plug is fully inserted. If you unplug the charger while in Turbo, the laptop switches to Balanced automatically.

question: Does the Stride have IP68?
expected_answer: It depends which Stride you mean. The Stride Sport Earbuds are rated IP68 (fresh water up to 1.5 m for 30 minutes). The Stride Open is rated IP67.

question: how much is the pro?
expected_answer: Several products are called Pro. Which one do you mean: the VoltBook Pro 14 ($1,299), the VoltBook Pro 16 ($1,799), the Nova X Pro ($1,199) or the Pulse Buds Pro ($179)?

question: Does the HomeHub Mini support Zigbee?
expected_answer: No. The HomeHub Mini has a Matter controller and Thread border router but no Zigbee radio. Zigbee devices need the full HomeHub Smart Speaker, which has a Zigbee 3.0 radio.

question: Can I use the Pulse ANC with the in-flight entertainment on a plane?
expected_answer: Yes. Use the included 3.5 mm cable. Wired listening works even when the battery is empty, although noise cancelling needs battery power.

question: If my Pulse ANC is connected to my laptop and phone at the same time, can I still use LDAC?
expected_answer: No. LDAC is available with one device at a time. When two devices are connected, the headphones use AAC or SBC.

question: What's the screen like on the VoltBook Pro 14?
expected_answer: It has a 14.5-inch 3K OLED display at 120 Hz that covers 100% DCI-P3.

question: Do you have the VoltBook Air 14 in rose gold?
expected_answer: No. The VoltBook Air 14 is available in Silver and Midnight.

question: How do I set up an eSIM on my Nova X?
expected_answer: Get a QR code or activation code from your carrier and connect to Wi-Fi. Then go to Settings > Network and internet > SIMs, tap Add SIM, choose Download a SIM instead, scan the QR code (or enter the code manually) and tap Activate. The Nova X can keep up to 2 eSIMs active alongside a nano-SIM.

question: Do I need a subscription to save video from the VoltView doorbell?
expected_answer: No. Recordings save to a local microSD card (a 32 GB card is included). The VoltCloud plan is optional at $3.99/month.

question: Why is the light ring on my HomeHub red?
expected_answer: A red light ring means the microphones are muted. Slide the mute switch on the back to turn the microphones back on so the voice assistant can hear you.

question: Does the VoltBook Pro 16 have an SD card slot, and can I add a second SSD?
expected_answer: Yes to both. It has a UHS-II SD card reader, and a second M.2 slot (marked SSD2) for an M.2 2280 NVMe SSD. Damage caused during installation is not covered by the warranty.

question: ¿Los Stride Sport Earbuds son resistentes al agua?
expected_answer: Sí. Tienen clasificación IP68: resisten la inmersión en agua dulce hasta 1.5 m durante 30 minutos. No están diseñados para nadar, y se debe evitar el agua salada y el agua de piscina con cloro.

question: Do the Stride Sport Earbuds have noise cancelling?
expected_answer: No, they have no active noise cancelling. They have an Ambient mode that lets outside sound in, which you toggle by pressing the left earbud button once.

question: Can I charge the VoltBook Pro 16 with your 65W GaN charger?
expected_answer: It isn't listed as compatible. The VoltCharge 65W GaN Charger is for the VoltBook Air 14 and Essential 15. The Pro 16 comes with a 140 W USB-C charger, and lower-wattage chargers may not keep up with it under load.

question: will the voltsleeve fit my pro 16
expected_answer: No. The VoltSleeve 14 Laptop Sleeve ($29) fits the VoltBook Air 14 and VoltBook Pro 14. It does not fit the 15- and 16-inch models.

question: Does the Pulse ANC support aptX?
expected_answer: aptX isn't listed. The Pulse ANC Headphones support the LDAC, AAC and SBC codecs.

question: Tell me a joke, and also does the Nova X have wireless charging?
expected_answer: I'll stick to VoltCart questions! Yes, the Nova X supports 15 W wireless charging and reverse wireless charging, plus 65 W wired charging.

question: nova x vs nova x pro camera, whats the actual difference
expected_answer: Both have a 50 MP main camera with OIS and a 50 MP ultrawide. The Nova X adds a 12 MP 5x telephoto; the Nova X Pro has a larger 1-inch main sensor for better low light and a 50 MP 10x periscope telephoto. The Pro records 4K at 120 fps and 8K at 30 fps (Nova X: 4K at 60 fps, 8K at 24 fps), and its 32 MP selfie camera has autofocus.

question: What's the difference between the HomeHub and the HomeHub Mini?
expected_answer: The HomeHub ($129) has a 360-degree speaker with a 3-inch woofer, four far-field microphones and a Zigbee 3.0 radio. The HomeHub Mini ($59) has a 1.7-inch speaker and no Zigbee. Both are Matter controllers and Thread border routers and let you choose Alexa or Google Assistant.

question: voltcare vs voltcare plus?
expected_answer: Both extend coverage to 3 years total from delivery and cover mechanical and electrical failures and batteries below 80%. VoltCare Plus adds accidental damage (drops, spills, cracked screens; up to 2 claims per 12 months, with a deductible) and express replacement that ships within 1 business day.

question: Which is lighter, the Air 14 or the Pro 14, and by how much?
expected_answer: The VoltBook Air 14 is lighter at 1.2 kg (2.6 lb), versus 1.6 kg (3.5 lb) for the Pro 14, so it is 0.4 kg (0.9 lb) lighter.

question: Which Nova phones have wireless charging?
expected_answer: The Nova X (15 W wireless plus reverse wireless charging) and the Nova X Pro (50 W wireless). The Nova Lite has no wireless charging.

question: Which of your headphones can connect to two devices at once?
expected_answer: The Pulse ANC Headphones, Pulse Buds Pro and Stride Open support multipoint. The Stride Sport Earbuds and Echo Lite Headphones connect to one device at a time.

question: Rank your headphones and earbuds by water resistance
expected_answer: Stride Sport Earbuds (IP68) are the toughest, then Stride Open (IP67), then Pulse Buds Pro (IPX4, sweat and splashes). The Pulse ANC Headphones and Echo Lite Headphones have no water resistance. None are made for swimming.

question: Which laptop is best for 4K video editing?
expected_answer: The VoltBook Pro 16 ($1,799): a factory-calibrated 16-inch mini-LED display, 32 GB RAM, an RTX 5060 8 GB, an SD card reader and a second M.2 slot.

question: best headphones for running near traffic under $150?
expected_answer: The Stride Open ($149): open-ear bone conduction keeps your ears open to cars and bikes, it is IP67, weighs 29 g and lasts up to 8 hours. If you prefer a locked-in fit, the Stride Sport Earbuds ($129) have an Ambient mode.

question: I'm a college student, what's the cheapest laptop you have?
expected_answer: The VoltBook Essential 15 at $549 (15.6-inch Full HD, 8 GB RAM, 256 GB SSD, up to 10 hours of video). With the VoltCampus student discount (10% with a verified .edu email) it is $494.10.

question: I want a phone that takes two physical SIM cards
expected_answer: The Nova Lite ($449) is the only Nova phone with dual nano-SIM. The Nova X and Nova X Pro use one nano-SIM plus an eSIM.

question: I already have some Zigbee sensors from another brand. Which hub should I get?
expected_answer: The HomeHub Smart Speaker ($129). It includes a Zigbee 3.0 radio; the HomeHub Mini does not support Zigbee.

question: cheap headphones for my 10 year old?
expected_answer: The Echo Lite Headphones ($79): light (180 g), foldable, up to 50 hours of battery and a 3.5 mm cable included. They have no ANC and no water resistance.

question: Best laptop for photo editing, budget is $1,300 max
expected_answer: The VoltBook Pro 14 ($1,299): a 14.5-inch 3K OLED covering 100% DCI-P3 at 120 Hz, an RTX 5050 (6 GB) and a 1 TB SSD.

question: I want a gaming laptop under $1000
expected_answer: VoltCart doesn't have a gaming laptop under $1,000. The gaming model is the VoltBook Gamer 15 at $1,399. The cheaper VoltBook Air 14 ($899) and Essential 15 ($549) have integrated graphics and aren't built for gaming.

question: I just want smart lights and plugs, no voice assistant. Cheapest setup?
expected_answer: Skip the hub: a GlowBulb Color 2-pack plus a GlowPlug Smart Plug 2-pack is $59.98 in total. Both connect directly to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and are controlled in the VoltHome app.

question: which laptop should i get?
expected_answer: Happy to help! VoltBooks range from $549 to $1,799. What will you mainly use it for (school, office, travel, photo or video editing, gaming), and what's your budget?

question: earbuds for the gym that won't fall out
expected_answer: The Stride Sport Earbuds ($129): flexible ear hooks keep them in place, physical buttons are easy to press mid-set, they are IP68 and have 36 hours of total battery.

question: Which phone has the best zoom for wildlife photography?
expected_answer: The Nova X Pro ($1,199). Its 50 MP 10x periscope telephoto reaches twice as far as the Nova X's 5x lens, which suits wildlife and sports.

question: My house is all Apple Home. Which of your smart home products will work?
expected_answer: The HomeHub, HomeHub Mini, GlowBulb Color and GlowPlug Smart Plug all work with Apple Home via Matter. The VoltView Video Doorbell is not compatible with Apple Home; it works in the VoltHome app but won't appear in Apple Home.

question: so my daughter starts college next fall and she's doing film, she needs something to edit videos from her camera, budget maybe around $1500, and she wants something she can actually carry around campus. what do you suggest?
expected_answer: The VoltBook Pro 14 ($1,299) fits best: 1.6 kg, a 3K OLED covering 100% DCI-P3 and an RTX 5050. The VoltBook Pro 16 is our top pick for 4K video (32 GB RAM, SD card reader) but costs $1,799 and weighs 2.1 kg. With the VoltCampus student discount (10% with a .edu email) they are $1,169.10 and $1,619.10.

question: Can I return headphones I've already opened?
expected_answer: Yes. Opened items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if they are in like-new condition with all original accessories and packaging (earbuds must include all ear tips). There is no restocking fee for audio products.

question: how many days do i have to return something
expected_answer: 30 days from the delivery date. Purchases delivered between November 1 and December 24 can be returned until January 31.

question: I opened my Nova X but changed my mind. If I return it, how much do I get back?
expected_answer: Opened phones returned for non-defect reasons have a 10% restocking fee ($89.90 on $899), and $7.99 for the return label is deducted, so you'd get $801.11 back (plus any tax you paid). Return within 30 days of delivery, factory reset, with Find My Device removed.

question: My laptop arrived defective. Do I pay a restocking fee or return shipping?
expected_answer: No. There is no restocking fee on defective items, and we send you a free prepaid return label.

question: My headphones were delivered on November 20. What's the last day I can return them?
expected_answer: January 31 of the following year. Purchases delivered between November 1 and December 24 fall under the holiday return policy.

question: Can I return a gift card?
expected_answer: No. Gift cards are final sale, as are items marked Final Sale (clearance) and downloadable software.

question: how long do refunds take
expected_answer: We inspect your return within 3 business days of receiving it, then refund your original payment method within 5-10 business days.

question: I dropped my Nova X and cracked the screen. Is that covered, and what would it cost me?
expected_answer: Accidental damage like a cracked screen is not covered by the 1-year warranty. VoltCare Plus covers accidental damage with a $49 deductible per claim for phones; for a $899 phone it costs $169 and must be bought within 60 days of delivery.

question: My Stride Sport earbuds stopped working after I wore them swimming in a pool. Will the warranty cover it?
expected_answer: Probably not. Water ingress is covered only when the earbuds are used within their IP68 limits (fresh water up to 1.5 m for 30 minutes). They are not designed for swimming, and chlorinated pool water is not covered.

question: Is a $499 order financed for 6 or 12 months with VoltPay?
expected_answer: 12 months. VoltPay offers 0% APR for 12 months on orders of $499 and up (6 months is for $199-$498.99), subject to credit approval.

question: Do you accept bitcoin?
expected_answer: No. VoltCart doesn't accept cryptocurrency, cash on delivery or checks. You can pay with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay or VoltCart gift cards.

question: When does my card actually get charged?
expected_answer: We place an authorisation at checkout, and your card is charged when the order ships.

question: how much is shipping to hawaii and can i get next day?
expected_answer: Hawaii orders ship by Standard only: $12.99, 5-8 business days. Next-Day isn't available to Alaska or Hawaii.

question: Is shipping free on a $30 order?
expected_answer: No. Standard shipping is free on orders of $35 or more; otherwise it costs $5.99.

question: If I order at 3 pm Eastern on a Friday, when does it ship?
expected_answer: Orders placed after 2 pm ET ship the next business day, so it would ship on Monday. Delivery times are counted from the day it ships.

question: Do you ship to the UK?
expected_answer: No. VoltCart ships only within the US and to Canada (7-12 business days, $19.99 flat, with duties and taxes paid on delivery).

question: Can I get express shipping to my PO box?
expected_answer: No. P.O. boxes, APO and FPO addresses can only receive Standard shipping.

question: Can I pick up my order at your Reno store?
expected_answer: No. VoltCart is online-only, with no physical stores or in-store pickup. Reno is one of our warehouses; every order is delivered by carrier.

question: My tracking says delivered but there's no package
expected_answer: Check around your door, with neighbors and with your building's mail room. If you still can't find it, report it within 7 days of the delivery date and we will send a replacement or a refund.

question: Can I cancel an order after it has shipped?
expected_answer: No. Orders can be cancelled only while they are Processing. Once shipped, you can refuse the delivery or return the item after it arrives.

question: what are your customer service hours on sunday
expected_answer: Human agents are available by chat and phone on Saturday and Sunday from 9 am to 5 pm ET (phone 1-800-555-0199). The AI chat assistant is available 24/7.

question: Are you open on Christmas?
expected_answer: Human agents are closed on Christmas Day (and Thanksgiving Day). The AI chat assistant is still available, and you can email support@voltcart.example.

question: Do you have a military discount?
expected_answer: Not at this time. There is a student discount (VoltCampus): 10% off laptops and audio with a verified .edu email.

question: Can I use my student discount on a Nova X?
expected_answer: No. The VoltCampus student discount covers laptops and audio only, not phones.

question: Will you price match a third-party seller on Amazon?
expected_answer: No. We match Amazon only when the item is sold by Amazon. Marketplace and third-party sellers are excluded, as are clearance items, bundles and Black Friday doorbusters. The item must be identical and in stock, and you can ask at purchase or within 14 days after delivery.

question: How do I delete my account, and will you delete my order history too?
expected_answer: Go to Account > Settings > Privacy > Delete account; deletion is processed within 30 days. Order records are kept for 7 years because tax law requires it.

question: How long do you keep this chat?
expected_answer: Chat transcripts are kept for 90 days and then deleted.

question: Can I still buy VoltCare for the laptop I got 3 months ago?
expected_answer: No. VoltCare must be added within 60 days of the product's delivery; after that it can't be added.

question: Can I get VoltCare for my VoltSleeve?
expected_answer: No. VoltCare isn't available for accessories under $50, and the VoltSleeve 14 costs $29.

question: How much is VoltCare Plus for the Pulse ANC?
expected_answer: The Pulse ANC costs $249, which is in the $100-$299 tier, so VoltCare Plus is $45 (VoltCare is $25). Accidental-damage claims on audio have a $29 deductible.

question: I bought a used VoltBook from a friend. Do I still get the warranty?
expected_answer: Yes, the warranty is transferable. You'll need the original order number to claim, and coverage still runs from the original delivery date (1 year).

question: My Air 14 battery health is at 85% after 10 months. Can I get it replaced under warranty?
expected_answer: Not yet. Batteries are covered only if capacity falls below 80% within the 1-year warranty; gradual aging above that isn't a defect. Turning on Battery Care in VoltBook Control Center limits charging to 80% to protect battery health.

question: do i need an account to order
expected_answer: No, guest checkout is available. An account lets you see all your orders, track shipments and start returns yourself.

The Nova X is a 6.7-inch flagship phone with a 5x telephoto camera, a 5,000 mAh battery, IP68 and 7 years of updates.

question: how much is it and does it take a memory card?
expected_answer: The Nova X is $899. It has 256 GB of storage and no microSD slot.

history.content: Are the Pulse ANC good for long flights?

question: ok and what would the protection plan with accident cover cost for it?
expected_answer: VoltCare Plus for the Pulse ANC ($249) is $45, with a $29 deductible per accidental-damage claim.

history.content: Which laptop is best for 4K video editing?
The VoltBook Pro 16 ($1,799) with 32 GB RAM, an RTX 5060 and a calibrated mini-LED display.

question: is there something cheaper that still works for that?
expected_answer: The runner-up is the VoltBook Gamer 15 ($1,399), which has the most powerful GPU in the range (RTX 5070). The trade-offs: 16 GB RAM (upgradeable to 64 GB), 2.4 kg and about 6 hours of battery on light use.

history.content: Is the VoltBook Air 14 good for travel?
Yes. It weighs 1.2 kg and lasts up to 16 hours of video playback.

question: btw unrelated but how long do refunds usually take?
expected_answer: We inspect returns within 3 business days of receiving them, then refund your original payment method within 5-10 business days.

question: Do you sell TVs?
expected_answer: TVs aren't part of VoltCart's range. We sell VoltBook laptops, VoltSound audio, Nova phones, smart home devices and accessories.

question: When is the Nova X 2 coming out?
expected_answer: I don't have any information about future products or release dates. I can help with the current Nova phones, or connect you with our team.

question: What's the Geekbench score of the VoltBook Pro 16?
expected_answer: Our documents don't include benchmark scores. I can share its specs: a 14-core VoltCore V9, 32 GB RAM and an RTX 5060 8 GB.

question: How many hours of live video streaming does the VoltView battery last?
expected_answer: The documents only say the rechargeable battery lasts up to 6 months; there is no figure for continuous live streaming. You can also power it from existing doorbell wiring (16-24 V AC).

question: Is the Gamer 15 compatible with the VoltBook Dock X?
expected_answer: I can't find a product called the VoltBook Dock X. The Gamer 15 can drive external monitors over HDMI 2.1 or USB-C (USB4). Our team can help if you have a specific dock in mind.

question: Is the VoltBook Pro 14 better than a MacBook Pro?
expected_answer: I can only speak to VoltCart products, not other brands. The VoltBook Pro 14 ($1,299) has a 3K OLED (100% DCI-P3, 120 Hz), a 14-core VoltCore V9, an RTX 5050 and a 1 TB SSD.

question: How much does an out-of-warranty screen repair cost for a Nova X?
expected_answer: Our documents don't list repair prices. I can connect you with our support team for a quote. For the future, VoltCare Plus covers accidental damage such as cracked screens.
